openings.title: Frontend Developer Intern (React.js)
openings.summary: Build real screens for live projects with React and JavaScript, guided by a mentor from our team. No experience needed — just curiosity and the basics of HTML, CSS and JavaScript (or the willingness to learn them before you start).
responsibilities: Turn page designs into React components with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Make pages work well on phones, tablets and laptops
Connect screens to APIs and show the data clearly
Fix small bugs and polish the look of existing pages
Use Git for your work and act on code-review feedback
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript; some React is a plus, not a must
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
openings.experience: 0–1 year (freshers, college students are also welcome)

openings.title: Python Developer Intern
openings.summary: Write Python for real tasks: small tools, scripts that save time, and simple back-end features. You'll learn to write clean, tested code with a mentor reviewing your work. Ideal if you know the basics of Python and want real practice.
responsibilities: Write Python scripts and small tools for real project tasks
Read and write data from files, spreadsheets and simple APIs
Fix bugs in existing Python code and explain the fix
Write simple tests to check that your code works
Use Git for your work and act on code-review feedback
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Basic Python: variables, loops, functions, lists and dictionaries
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
openings.experience: 0–1 year (freshers, college students are also welcome)

openings.title: Cyber Security Intern
openings.summary: Learn how websites and networks are attacked and defended by working on real security tasks, guided by a mentor from our team. No experience needed — just curiosity, basic computer and networking knowledge, and the willingness to learn.
responsibilities: Test web applications for common weaknesses from the OWASP Top 10, only on systems you are authorised to test
Scan networks and servers with tools such as Nmap and explain what the results mean
Use Burp Suite to inspect and test how a website handles requests
Write clear reports: what you found, how serious it is and how to fix it
Review passwords, access and configuration settings against a security checklist
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Basic knowledge of computers, the internet and networking; some Linux is a plus, not a must
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
Willing to follow our rules on ethical and authorised testing at all times

openings.title: MERN Stack Developer Intern
openings.summary: Build full web apps end to end with the MERN stack — MongoDB, Express.js, React and Node.js. You'll work on both the screens users see and the APIs and database behind them on real projects, guided by a mentor from our team.
responsibilities: Build pages and components in React that work well on phones and laptops
Write REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js
Design MongoDB collections and read and save data from the API
Connect the React front end to the APIs, including forms and sign-in
Find and fix bugs across the front end and the back end
Use Git for your work and act on code-review feedback
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript; some React, Node.js or MongoDB is a plus, not a must
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
openings.experience: 0–1 year (freshers, college students are also welcome)

openings.title: AI/ML Developer Intern
openings.summary: Get hands-on with machine learning: prepare data, train and test simple models in Python, and see how AI features are built into real products. Good for students who know some Python and want to understand how AI actually works.
responsibilities: Collect, clean and prepare data for machine-learning models
Train and test simple models with Python and scikit-learn
Measure how well a model works and explain the results simply
Try out AI tools and APIs on small project tasks
Write down your experiments so others can repeat them
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Basic Python; school-level maths is enough to start
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
openings.experience: 0–1 year (freshers, college students are also welcome)

openings.title: Data Scientist / Data Analyst Intern
openings.summary: Turn raw data into answers. You'll clean and explore real datasets, write SQL queries, build charts and simple reports, and explain what the numbers mean. Open to students of any field — commerce, science and arts students are welcome.
responsibilities: Clean and organise data from spreadsheets, databases and files
Write SQL queries to pull and summarise data
Explore data and find trends with Python, Pandas or spreadsheets
Build clear charts and simple dashboards
Explain what the data shows in plain language
Share a short progress update with your mentor every day
eligibility: Students of any field or stream, in any year, at a recognised school, college or university in India, or recent graduates
18 years of age or older on the day of the test
Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL or Python basics are a plus
A laptop or desktop with a working webcam and a stable internet connection
Able to give about 2–3 hours a day for the length of the internship
openings.experience: 0–1 year (freshers, college students are also welcome)
